background_image_description: Soft left-to-right gradient background transitioning from pastel pink (#F2A3B3) on the left 0–55% into vivid warm yellow (#FFD11A) on the right 55–100%, with a subtle warm glow centered slightly right of middle.

nodes.asset_description: Studio photo of a young woman with long straight blonde hair wearing a green button-up shirt, smiling and holding her right hand up making an 'OK' gesture. She is framed from chest up, slightly left of center. The photo includes a soft pink backdrop behind her that blends into the overall gradient on the right.

nodes.svg_description: Yellow halftone dot field overlay: circular dots (#FFC61A, ~85% opacity) arranged on a grid with dot size increasing toward the bottom-left corner, fading to transparent toward the top-right. The cluster forms a diagonal sweep from left-bottom toward center-right.
Rounded rectangle button filled with near-black (#111111) with approximately 12 px corner radius.
Right-pointing isosceles triangle arrow, filled #111111, aligned to the vertical center of the button and placed slightly to its right.
